task: A failed verification command sometimes loses the failing assertion in the short tool message even though the full log contains it. Find the code that assembles the failure summary.
A recovery handle from one coding session appears usable to fetch another session's stored command output. Find the storage boundary that must enforce session isolation.
When the provider's available models change, the workhorse choice can land on a premium model. Find the model selection logic that interprets provider listings.
A task escalates after fewer failed verification cycles than configured. Find the threshold decision responsible for that transition.
The terminal sidebar footer loses the current build identifier when a session changes. Find the code that renders the footer badge.
The launcher refuses to start when another Relay plugin is already registered. Find the startup check for duplicate registrations.
Recorded input tokens increase twice for one assistant completion. Find the per-session accounting that consumes completed assistant messages.
A benchmark reports a captured context packet as valid even though the saved text differs from its digest. Find the capture validation in the benchmark harness.
A passing tool command still floods the assistant with the complete raw output instead of a short success preview. Find the preview transformation.
The startup toast shows the wrong build label for the running Relay channel. Find the function that composes that toast.
